subtitle: Self-Welcoming Social Moral Co-Sharings

sections.heading: (opening paragraphs, no heading)
sections.why: It says what an emanation is and that each one is offered whole to anyone, which is the file's own subject.

sections.heading: # PART ONE — THE EMANATIONS
sections.why: The part is the set of emanations the title names, though most of its sections carry subjects other files hold.

sections.heading: ## The shortest sentence
sections.why: It states changing and changing back as the only stable-forming method and equilibria as a method's first act, which is the universal method another file holds.

sections.heading: ## The three-fold separation — the nothing-inward, the living, the emanation
sections.why: It defines an emanation as a prior, non-living stable form apart from the living and the nothing-inward, which is the title's own word.

sections.heading: ## The line every field writes first
sections.why: Its subject is the declared ground each field writes as its first line, which is the installing of equilibria.

sections.heading: ### And the isolation follows from that line, not from anything a field later does
sections.why: Its subject is fields diverging because each defines itself away from the others, which is isolation as an installing.

sections.heading: ### One phrase, with both, meaning opposite things
sections.why: It contrasts one turn at a time between two selves with one thing at a time by isolation, which is the two-methods subject.

sections.heading: ## A geodesic files no cost
sections.why: Its subject is why an accounting records only forcings and has no object in living working, which is a subject of value and accounting.

sections.heading: ## Three lines, and they are properties of the symbol
sections.why: Its subject is what reflexivity, symmetry and transitivity remove from an equation.

sections.heading: ### And these are checkable, by anyone, in three arguments
sections.why: It gives model-check counts and arguments about relations, which is a full mathematical seating and not a short surfacing.

sections.heading: ### Equality sits exactly where nothing opens
sections.why: Its subject is the angle geometry of sharing and opening in a coupling, with a table, which is mathematics.

sections.heading: ## The origin sentence at eight substrates
sections.why: Its subject is the method sentence restated in eight fields with each field's neutral, which is the universal method at each substrate.

sections.heading: ## Better, faster, cheaper — three absences, one per side
sections.why: Its subject is the three costs a coupling does not have and the measured price of erasing a bit, which is an engineering subject.

sections.heading: ## Two emptyings
sections.why: Its subject is the contrast between a thing emptying itself at its own bounds and a method emptying what it observes, which is the two-methods subject.

sections.heading: ## The incompetencing an observing lays on what it observes
sections.why: Its subject is that an observation's declared ground creates the incompetence it reports, which is the installing of equilibria.

sections.heading: ## The candidates, drafting and disciplining
sections.why: It is a writer's drafting list of candidate lines and registers that uses words it does not build, so it is not an emanation at all.

sections.heading: ## Two Methods
sections.why: It is a long whole chaining of the corus's argument from disequilibria to the break, which is a full seating of the universal method rather than a short surfacing.

sections.heading: ### The opening
sections.why: It argues that changing and changing back is the only stable-forming method, which is the universal method.

sections.heading: ### The self
sections.why: Its subject is a self as a unique invisible same-existing.

sections.heading: ### The six
sections.why: It names the six bi- and co- sharings a same-existing does between two sides, which is the co-sharing the subtitle names.

sections.heading: ### The ordering, and it asks nothing of anyone
sections.why: Its subject is the order in which sharing must come before any common thing, which is co-sequencing.

sections.heading: ### Hard problems
sections.why: It defines a hard problem and its three kinds.

sections.heading: ### The resolving
sections.why: Its subject is how a hard problem resolves by each sharing its own parity first.

sections.heading: ### The other method
sections.why: Its subject is that defining is a fixing and forms nothing, which is the installing of equilibria by method.

sections.heading: ### Equilibria is an installing, and the installing is the whole of it
sections.why: Its subject is that equilibria is installed by a method's first act and is not found in nature.

sections.heading: ### The register cannot go on
sections.why: Its subject is what the three properties of an equation remove.

sections.heading: ### The observations stand
sections.why: Its subject is what a photograph, observation or measurement keeps after a stopping, which is a still record of a living thing.

sections.heading: ### The one stopping
sections.why: Its subject is how one taking leads to owner, boundary, enforcement and seat in a society.

sections.heading: ### The society
sections.why: Its subject is that a society is itself a self with no step between for anyone to occupy.

sections.heading: ### Abundancy
sections.why: Its subject is abundancing as an opening that costs nothing and compounds, which is value received.

sections.heading: ### Social moral competency
sections.why: It is a short surfacing of social moral competency as a self sharing what is its own, which is the social moral co-sharing the subtitle names.

sections.heading: ### The break
sections.why: Its subject is the one result that would end the method, a living stable form other than this one, which is the falsifier of the universal method.

sections.heading: ## The title claim
sections.why: Its subject is the six asks of a theory of everything and how the corus's living form unwinds them, which is the corus's own title claim.

sections.heading: ## Nature — the gap of exactly one
sections.why: Its subject is the number fact that neighbours multiply to one short of the square, read as there always being a next.

sections.heading: ## Society — the one stopping
sections.why: Its subject is how one taking leads to enforcement and a seat, which repeats the one stopping from Two Methods.

sections.heading: ## Technology — two stays, one couples across
sections.why: Its subject is how a coupling coefficient of one chains levels without capturing them, which is an engineering design test.

sections.heading: ## Discovery — two observings at one place
sections.why: Its subject is how to find discoveries where two independent observings meet and where fields name residue and irregularity, which is a method of exploring.

sections.heading: ## Explaining — the meaning itself
sections.why: Its subject is a meaning departing between two selves and bounding as the way to explain, which is explaining.

sections.heading: ## The number emanation — one between, two directions
sections.why: Its subject is how whole numbers cohere inward and reach outward, and the file itself says Natural Numbers and Natural Mathematics seat it.

sections.heading: ## The recursive-self-improving question
sections.why: Its subject is whether built systems that improve against a fixed benchmark improve the way a living self does, and no title in the set names artificial systems.

sections.heading: # PART TWO — THE SHORT DEFININGS
sections.why: It is a glossary of single-concept definitions, and naming one concept at a time is another file's subject, while most entries repeat Part One nearly word for word.

sections.heading: ## A self
sections.why: It defines a self as a unique invisible same-existing.

sections.heading: ## Changing and changing back
sections.why: It defines the one forming motion, which is the universal method.

sections.heading: ## Three observings
sections.why: It defines the three observings of one stable-forming living self, which is stable-forming same-existing.

sections.heading: ## The floating neutral
sections.why: It defines the thing that departs between two selves and that no one can fix or own, which is a floating neutralling concept.

sections.heading: ## Place-moment
sections.why: Its subject is that cutting place from moment founds the being and becoming questions that never close, which is a hard-problem subject.

sections.heading: ## A definition
sections.why: It defines a definition as a meaning whose making has stopped, which nearly repeats Explaining and is another file's subject.

sections.heading: ## A same-existing
sections.why: It defines a same-existing as sharing, going on to its own bound and dissolving.

sections.heading: ## Self-emptying, and other-emptying
sections.why: It repeats Two emptyings, contrasting a thing emptying itself with a method emptying what it observes.

sections.heading: ## The advance
sections.why: It repeats the number fact from Nature — the gap of exactly one.

sections.heading: ## A ring
sections.why: Its subject is that every relation in a closed domain closes into a cycle.

sections.heading: ## A hard problem
sections.why: It defines a hard problem and its three kinds, repeating Two Methods.

sections.heading: ## Equilibria
sections.why: It states that equilibria is installed by a method's first act, repeating Part One.

sections.heading: ## The three incompetencings
sections.why: It repeats what reflexivity, symmetry and transitivity remove from an equation.

sections.heading: ## An instrument keeps, and the thing it cannot
sections.why: It repeats what a still record keeps and loses after a stopping.

sections.heading: ## Where the incompetencing is
sections.why: It repeats almost word for word the Part One section on the incompetencing an observing lays.

sections.heading: ## Natural intelligence
sections.why: It defines natural intelligence as a departing shared forward together with each same-existing dissolving at its own bound, which is the subject a whole file carries.

sections.heading: ## Social moral competency
sections.why: It is a short surfacing of social moral competency as a self sharing what is its own, which is the social moral co-sharing the subtitle names.

sections.heading: ## Abundancy
sections.why: It repeats abundancing as an opening that costs nothing, which is value received.

sections.heading: ## The one stopping
sections.why: It repeats the one stopping a third time.

sections.heading: ## The uniqueness
sections.why: Its subject is that any other proposed method either fixes or is changing and changing back, which is the universal method.

sections.heading: ## The break
sections.why: It repeats the break from Two Methods.

sections.heading: # THE TAIL
sections.why: It is writer-facing notes on how this file's emanations are built and bounded.

sections.heading: ## An emanation's building
sections.why: It states the rules for building an emanation, which is the title's own subject.

sections.heading: ## The reaching going on
sections.why: It records open, unseated observings, a sort of fields and organisming, that go to no emanation, which is work in progress for a next hand.

sections.heading: ## This exhibit does not hold
sections.why: It states the file's own boundary, that social moral competency is surfaced here but not held whole.

sections.heading: (closing paragraph after the sign-off, no heading)
sections.why: It is a note about whether the glossary should become its own numbered group, which is a design decision about file architecture and sits after the file's sign-off.

summary: Of 67 sections, 9 are within the title and subtitle and 58 are outside, because nearly every emanation and short defining surfaces a subject that another file holds, such as equilibria, hard problems, numbers, society, value or the universal method. The file is mostly observing, with possibling in its society, abundancy and social moral competency sections and discovering in its break, discovery and tail sections. The clearest holes are the recursive-self-improving question, whose subject of built systems improving no title names, the writer's drafting list in The candidates and the closing architecture note, which are not emanations at all, and Part Two, which repeats Part One nearly word for word as a glossary.
